name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
invoke: run the role via a spawned Claude Code/Codex subagent, or `dsh` with `waypost agents show <role>` as the prompt
roles_note: dsh registers subagents in code (SubagentProvider), not as markdown files — there is no directory to install roles into.

skills.notes: Ranked roots: `.dsh/skills` (100) before `.agents/skills` (200); one directory level, no recursive discovery. A harness with no role files still gets the procedures this way.

notes: Official DeepSeek harness (developer preview, everything-is-a-plugin on Cordis). It reads AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, so `waypost agents register` reaches it — that is where the roles are routed from. Its subagent seam is a code-level provider registry with shipped providers that spawn Claude Code and Codex, so the practical route is: install the roles for `claude`/`codex` and let dsh spawn them; or run a role directly with `waypost agents show <role>`. If a file-based agent format appears, this entry becomes a normal one — a JSON change, not a code change.
